mock.description: The approved mock the item comes from (a link to its row).

n.description: The item's place in the build order: the mock tree's walk, and within a screen the screen, its state, its changes, its decisions, its actions.

kind.description: What is owed: a whole screen, a state reached for real, an action that leads where the tree says, a proposed change, a decision as answered.

step.description: The screen id the item is on.

ref.description: The action, change or decision id on that screen; absent for the screen itself and its state.

title.description: What is owed, in one sentence.

sig.description: A hash of the mock content the item came from. A redraw changes it, and the item starts again at todo.

where.description: Where the product carries it: the file or component (mockify plan), then the place in the running product.

status.description: todo: not built; built: in the code, not yet proven; matches: proven beside the mock screen (needs shot); differs: built but not as drawn (note says what); not_checked: could not be checked (note says why); flagged: cannot be built as drawn -- the screen is redrawn and re-approved first.

note.description: What differs, why it was not checked, or the flag.

shot.description: A screenshot of the built product showing the item, taken beside the mock screen.
